from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,shutil,datetime,difflib
root=Path.cwd(); stage=root/"logs/v0.2.3"; stage.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
pdfdir=stage/"pdf";pdfdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
old=json.loads((root/"logs/v0.2.2/input_hashes.json").read_text())
paths={Path(p) for p in old}
paths.update((root/"LeanPML").rglob("*.lean"));paths.discard(root/"LeanPML/PML/LocalSpatial.lean")
paths.update(p for p in (root/"docs").rglob("*") if p.is_file())
paths.update(p for p in (root/"logs").rglob("*") if p.is_file() and not p.is_relative_to(stage))
paths.update([root/"lean-toolchain",root/"lakefile.toml",root/"lake-manifest.json",root/"scripts/run_logged.py"])
sources=root.parent/"results/V7_Maxwell_Debye_PML"
paths.update([sources/"V7_global_energy.pdf",sources/"V7_global_energy.tex",sources/"V7_global_energy.md"])
paths.update(p for p in (sources/"output").rglob("*") if p.is_file())
digest=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
hashes={str(p):digest(p) for p in sorted(paths) if p.is_file()}
(stage/"input_hashes.json").write_text(json.dumps(hashes,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
for name in ["README.md","PROGRESS.md","LeanPML.lean","Audit.lean","ROADMAP_lean_PML_revised.md"]:
 shutil.copy2(root/name,stage/("before_"+name))
previous=(root/"logs/v0.2.2/before_ROADMAP_lean_PML_revised.md").read_text()
current=(root/"ROADMAP_lean_PML_revised.md").read_text()
(stage/"roadmap_preexisting_diff.patch").write_text("".join(difflib.unified_diff(previous.splitlines(True),current.splitlines(True),fromfile="v0.2.2 input",tofile="v0.2.3 input")))
target=sources/"V7_global_energy_副本.pdf"
stamp=datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
backup=pdfdir/("before_v0.2.3_"+stamp+".pdf")
with backup.open("xb") as f:f.write(target.read_bytes())
meta={"target":str(target),"backup":str(backup),"sha256_before":digest(target),"bytes_before":target.stat().st_size}
(pdfdir/"backup.json").write_text(json.dumps(meta,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
changed=[p for p,h in old.items() if digest(Path(p))!=h]
print("受保护文件:",len(hashes));print("相对上阶段输入变化:",changed)
print("V7 md:",digest(sources/"V7_global_energy.md"));print("路线图:",digest(root/"ROADMAP_lean_PML_revised.md"))
print("PDF本轮备份:",json.dumps(meta,ensure_ascii=False))
